assumptions: 1. THE CREATORS DECLARE NOTHING YET (VELDO-0302 is not built). The suite declares and confirms each item itself, with the kind and parent design 6.10 gives it: a clone's root and scratch folder as scratch, its work tree as an agent repository inside the root, a run directory as scratch owned by its dispatch, a candidate folder and a candidate workspace as agent repositories. The removal paths find their items by path, so they do not depend on where a creator stores an identity. A thing no item records is not removed (rows ac1/fleet-not-recorded, paths/absent-only-when-not-found).

2. THE TABLE HAS NO CELL FOR A PRIVATE REPOSITORY AT RUN FINISHED (VELDO-0347 is not built). The suite's ledger and registry are a copy of the current table with one cell added: agent repository at run finished, remove. On today's table a clone's work tree and a candidate folder are not made due at run finished: they stay, the root waits, the pins stay held and the teardown is refused. Not proven here: that row itself, and the snapshot of a worker clone of an ended run (0347), which is why ac2/uncommitted-stays shows keep_failed.

3. NOTHING IN THE ENGINE BUILDS `space` YET. The service holds no Ledger. The suite wires the mapping itself. In production the five paths run their no-ledger branch until a later ticket wires it. Since the review that branch looks before it deletes (assumption 5).

4. OBJECTS MADE WITHOUT THEIR STORES. The clone provisioner, the receiver, the runner and the landing line's runtime are made with object.__new__ and the attributes their removal methods read; the lander's ops likewise. The dispatch records are a mapping, the process table a fixture folder, the docker client a function, and the two checks of a switch to act allow. For ac2/failed-provision the provisioner's accepted source, its protection and its verify are replaced so that the provisioning fails after the checkout, and uuid4 is fixed so the suite can declare the items first.

5. WITH NO LEDGER THE DELETES ARE STILL MADE BY THE MODULES, in the branch that runs only when `space` is None, and since the review only after the look of control_space_standalone answered for the thing: the unique work probe, the removers' reading of ignored work, the probe for repositories beneath it, and the keep step with the kept refs as its only record (no ledger holds a keep record). Design 6.10 says none of these paths calls a delete itself after the change; that holds with a ledger (row paths/no-delete-with-a-ledger) and not without one. NOT PROVEN: that nothing changes the thing between the look and the delete. The wired removers move the thing to a marked name and look once more; this branch does not. Its callers have just read that the run's processes are gone.

6. NOT BUILT, FOR THE LEAD: a clone whose teardown is refused keeps its dispatch's worker slot (control_retirement.py, outside this footprint). Since the review this is reached with no ledger too: a clone whose work tree holds a file in no commit stays, and its dispatch keeps its slot. VELDO-0308 AC4 (added by this fix, not built) closes the obligation at hand-over and moves the pin release to the work tree's removal outcome.
7. THE LANDING LINE'S EVENT is run finished, by the build's reading of design section 5 and 6.10; the design does not name it.

8. TWO OLDER ROWS WERE CHANGED, because they stated the behaviour the owner's rule forbids. 66_veldo_0042 clone/retire-after-users-end and clone/retire-waits-for-group retired a clone that held an untracked file the worker's probe wrote; the first now also asserts the refusal space_deferred:unique_work with the pins held, and both remove the file before the teardown that removes the clone. 128_veldo_0235 local/lands asserted no fetch in the logging git; the keep step's fetch from the candidate workspace (a folder on this host) into the caller is told apart by its form and asserted to be the only one, and the row still refuses any other fetch, push or ls-remote. This is a judgment of the fix, for the reviewer to confirm.

9. THE REVIEW THIS FIX ANSWERS is outside the repository (research/claude-runs/review-veldo-0303.md of the lead's workspace, verdict FIX, findings 1 to 5 on commits cd4acb20 and c203b6d0). Finding 4 is answered by a spec amendment only (VELDO-0308 AC4). The fix has had no review of its own.

10. EVERY TEARDOWN, CLOSE AND DISCARD NOW WRITES KEPT REFS in the main repository, under refs/veldo/kept/<unit or none>/standalone-<folder>-<digest of the path>/, and for a clone and a candidate fetches their objects into it, attachment refs of other repositories included. Nothing deletes them. Their growth was not measured.

11. A SUITE OUTSIDE THE LEAD'S LIST IS RED HERE AND WAS RED BEFORE THIS FIX: 86_veldo_0127_agent_configuration, run on its own, fails the same 27 rows on a clean clone of c203b6d0 and on this tree (the two lists were compared and are equal). Its registered case role127-staged-skill-outlives-run, whose anchor is in the receiver's run removal, finds its anchor exactly once; its target row is among those 27, so the case could not be shown red or green here.
